verdict.rationale: Persona's docs say webhooks can notify your service about events on any Persona resource, including real-time status updates on approval, decline, or review. They also document event filters to subscribe to only a subset of events, attribute blocklists, custom HTTP headers, and OAuth 2.0 authentication for outbound deliveries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery reliability, details on retry/signature verification.
